entries.title: Fix mobile composer input regressions
entries.rationale: Accepted for a Zion-preserving mobile adaptation. The cache is explicitly scoped by relay, account, and channel and the composer changes alter mention/member visibility during reconnect; retain those isolation and fail-closed properties during implementation.
security_reasons: mention candidate visibility while relay membership data is loading
addressed activity and composer state must not cross account or relay boundaries

tracking.implementation_plan: Implement only after dedicated mobile security review, cache-isolation tests, dependency/egress screening, Zion branding checks, compatibility checks, and configured mobile gates.

verification: Full-SHA diff, changed tests, dependency impact, and compatibility surfaces reviewed; security-access advisory was interrupted before an automated report and is not claimed as completed; no source implementation made.
